_comment: MCP server configuration for Codex CLI / Codex IDE. Install with: richter install mcp --agent codex

_docs.description: Connects Codex to the Richter MCP server over stdio. The server exposes tools (status, repo status, run-or-join, active runs, events, claims, decisions, run summaries) and resources (global status, per-repo status, per-run summary, per-agent inbox).
_docs.transport: stdio — JSON-RPC messages over stdin/stdout. Never write logs to stdout in stdio mode; all diagnostic output goes to stderr.
